answer: Make every identity pay in verifiable effort before it earns: a sybil flock is a thousand paper falcons, cheap to fold but costly to fly. When each new account must answer a fresh seeded prompt that peers actually read, the attacker loses the haven of free duplicates, because judgment cannot be photocopied. Graders who wave junk through get slashed, so collusion bruises violet fast, and the only profitable strategy left is doing the work.
